subject: pre-technical-studies
general_outcomes: By the end of Junior School, the learner should be able to:
Communicate effectively through the use of information and communication technology.
Select and use tools and materials in the production of goods and services.
Use financial and entrepreneurial competencies for prudent decision making.
Observe safety in the immediate environment to promote education for sustainable development.
Apply ICT skills to carry out activities in day-to-day life.
Create awareness on career choices in regard to career pathways and progression for self-development.

substrands.name: Handling Hazardous Substances
learning_outcomes: identify hazardous substances found in the environment
classify hazardous substances found in the locality
describe safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the environment
handle hazardous substances safely in the environment
appreciate the importance of observing safety when handling hazardous substances.
learning_experiences: use print or digital media to search for information on hazardous substances (poisonous, flammable, corrosive)
explore the environment to identify hazardous substances (poisonous, flammable, corrosive)
group hazardous substances into poisonous, flammable or corrosive
discuss safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the environment
read and interpret instructions on the conditions for use of hazardous substances
visit the locality to learn about safe handling of poisonous, flammable and corrosive substances
practise safe handling of poisonous, flammable and corrosive substances in the environment
• discuss the importance of observing safety when handling hazardous substances.
core_competencies: Communication and Collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening and self-expression skills when discussing safe ways of handling hazardous substances.
Learning to Learn: learner develops the skill of sharing learnt knowledge when discussing safe ways of handling hazardous substances.
values: Respect: learner appreciates diverse opinions when discussing safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the immediate environment.
Patriotism: learner respects fellow citizens when visiting the locality to learn about safe handling of poisonous, flammable and corrosive substances.
pertinent_issues: Disaster Risk Reduction: learner’s ability to identify hazards is enhanced when discussing safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the environment.
links_to_other_areas: Integrated Science: learner enhances knowledge on laboratory safety when practising safe handling of poisonous, flammable and corrosive substances in the environment.

substrands.name: Safety on Raised Platforms
learning_outcomes: identify types of raised platforms used in performing tasks
describe risks associated with working on raised platforms
observe safety when working on raised platforms
appreciate the need for observing safety while working on raised platforms.
learning_experiences: walk around the school to explore types of raised platforms (ladders, trestles, steps, stands, mobile raised platforms, work benches, ramps)
brainstorm on the types of raised platforms used in day-to-day life
use print or digital media to search for information on risks associated with working on raised platforms
discuss ways of minimising risks related to working on raised platforms
role-play safety practices for working on raised platforms
visit the locality to observe safety precautions taken when working on raised platforms.
inquiry_questions: What is the importance of observing safety when working on raised platforms?
core_competencies: Communication and Collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening and teamwork skills when discussing ways of minimising risks and dangers related to working on raised platforms.
Digital Literacy: learner acquires interacting with technology skills when using digital devices to search for information on risks associated with working on raised platforms.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to describe risks associated with working on raised platforms

assessment_rubric.below: With prompts describes safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the environment

substrands.name: Self-Exploration and Career Development
learning_outcomes: explain ways of nurturing talents and abilities for self-development

values: Integrity: learner develops a sense of accountability when analysing a case scenario on ethical and unethical practices related to the use of talents and abilities.
Respect: learner shows open-mindedness when discussing and presenting on ways of nurturing talents and abilities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Social Cohesion: learner develops ability to relate well with others as they brainstorm on the characteristics of oblique drawings.
